text:
mika: Quick sync: QA found a weird spike in "per-model cache savings" for tenant X after we enabled sticky routing. Need to decide whether to show historical backfilled savings or only post-rollout.

arjun: rough cause: sticky routing increases hotkey reuse which skews amortized cache credits. Two options:
- backfill with adjusted route-weight (hard)
- start fresh at rollout (loses historical continuity)

lia: UX prefer showing both: a "post-rollout baseline" ribbon on the heatmap + a toggle to overlay pre-rollout series. avoids misleading comparisons.

samir: telemetry note: we currently compute cache_credit as:
```
cache_credit = observed_kv_hits * expected_prefetch_cost_per_key
```
but expected_prefetch_cost_per_key varies by model_variant and quantization; we didn't tag that historically.

mika: ugh. so historical numbers are not comparable until we retroactively attach model_variant. backfilling would require reprocessing raw traces.

arjun: reprocessing pipeline estimate: ~6 hours cluster time for last 30 days, ~2TB scan. Can do but it's delayed.

lia: product asks for an "exposure" column in tenants table: conservative estimate of delta if we changed routing. Proposal: compute an upper/lower bound using two heuristics (no backfill vs optimistic backfill).

samir: code snippet for heuristics:
```
heuristic_low = observed_cache_savings_post * route_weight_change
heuristic_high = observed_cache_savings_post * (1 + variant_delta_pct)
```
We need variant_delta_pct emitted by infra.

mika: who owns emitting variant delta? arjun?

arjun: infra+research will push per-variant avg token cost and latency. They promised a patch this week. once available we can refine heuristics.

lia: small UX ask: in the cost heatmap, add a micro-tooltip explaining "hysteresis" (quota smoothing) so PMs don't freak when quotas cause slow ramp of savings.

mika: good call. also add "confidence" overlay (low/med/high) computed from sampling rate and backfill completeness.

samir: sampling complication: we sample econ events at 1/100. To estimate per-tenant monthly delta we currently scale by 100, but under sticky routing sampling bias increases. Need a bias-corrector.

arjun: propose we emit a bias_metric per-tenant: ratio(sampled_mean, full_scan_mean) computed nightly from a 0.5% full-trace job. cheaper than full backfill.

lia: will wire UI to surface bias_metric in the tenant details flyout. copy will say "If bias > 1.1, estimates may be inflated due to sampling under reuse patterns." simple.

mika: question for rollouts: do we gate the heatmap feature behind "econ-preview" flag for customers? product leans yes until backfill is done.

samir: ops-bot: can you confirm current ingest pipeline supports per-variant tagging? we need to know if any late-arriving variant tags will be attached to past traces.

ops-bot: ingest: per-variant tag support deployed (v3.4). Late-arriving tags are accepted but not auto-joined to existing aggregates. Backfill job required to retro-attach.

ops-bot: deploy: econ-heatmap-service v1.3 -> canary succeeded (3/3 hosts).

arjun: plan:
1) ship heatmap preview with clear "post-rollout baseline" ribbon + sampling toggle.
2) schedule nightly 0.5% full-trace job for bias_metric.
3) offer reprocess backfill as a deferred job (manual trigger) for tenants that request historic continuity.

lia: UX checklist before ship:
- ribbon for post-rollout baseline
- toggle to overlay historical series
- confidence band legend
- tooltip for hysteresis + sampling bias
- tenant flyout shows bias_metric and expected_monthly_delta (low/med/high)

mika: ops checklist:
- confirm backfill job playbook
- cost estimate to run backfill per-tenant
- add billing disclaimer copy

samir: I'll prototype bias-corrector and run night job sample tomorrow. if bias_metric stable <1.05, we can relax the "preview" label sooner.

lia: I'll draft tooltip copy and mock for PM review. handing off in 90m.

mika: thanks team. meet 15m before merge. :rocket:
